_readme: Documented exceptions to engine/people-evidence.mjs's whole-word name check, as "personId|book/chapter/verse": "reason". Add one only when the verse is genuinely about the person but names them by a form the catalog does not list (for example, a title or pronoun the text itself makes plain). Say why in the batch's commit message; do not add an entry to silence a verse that was simply mis-cited. Content-fidelity decisions belong to the Timeline Researcher through the CEO (CYB-313).
